verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, which gives it its own access control and isolation between users and organizations. The founder separately mentions per-user graphs with user permissions. The evidence does not describe roles, policies, ACL granularity, read versus write permission distinctions, or any audit logging of memory access. Missing for 10: documented roles/policies/ACL model with read/write granularity, audit logging of access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can govern who and what can read or write memory with roles, policies, or access-control lists, and audit that access

citations.quote: This system provides data isolation and access control through dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, enabling multiple users or organizations to use the same Cognee instance while keeping their data completely separate.
we have graphs per user now available. So, user permissions + graph filtering.
